verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Unit is a middleware/BaaS platform that 'works with one or multiple bank partners' and is a Fed service provider acting 'on behalf of partner banks' (unit-docs-6, unit-docs-7), giving a founder basic awareness that Unit itself is not the chartered bank. But there is no naming of specific partner banks per customer, no disclosure of which bank actually holds funds for a given program, and no statement of what happens to customer funds/accounts if Unit as a company fails. Missing for 10: named sponsor bank per program, FDIC pass-through insurance details, and explicit business-continuity/failure-of-platform disclosures.
